thread:
ada: Quick UX pass on the compact dashboard in dark mode. Two issues: 1) mini-sparklines fade into the panel shadow, 2) heatmap colors are indistinguishable for some CVd types. dropping a small palette suggestion and an accessibility toggle.

tom: paste the vars pls so I can try in storybook.

ada: copying: --bg:#0c0f11; --panel:#101214; --muted:#99a3aa; --brand:#63c7ff; --spark:rgba(99,199,255,0.65); --heat-low:#45b6a6; --heat-med:#ffdb78; --heat-high:#ff775e

nina: spark alpha still dips when panel has inset shadow. bump to 0.9 or add a 1px outer glow on hover.

paul: for heatmap, propose pattern overlay (diagonal hatch) when "Heatmap: high-contrast patterns" is enabled in Settings. avoids relying on hue alone.

sam: legend in compact layout: collapse to an icon with hover-expand. keyboard users need clear focus ring (3:1).

ada: plan: 1) sparkline opacity -> 0.9 + hover glow, 2) heatmap swap low->blue-green, med->yellow, high->warm red, 3) optional pattern toggle with tooltip: "Improves readability for color-vision differences.", 4) collapse legend into hover/keyboard-expand in compact. I'll open a PR with CSS vars + storybook fixture and attach a Figma frame.

design-bot: frame uploaded: https://figma.com/file/heatmap-compact-dark (ada/compact-dark-accessibility)

ada: thanks all ":white_check_mark:"
